description: This file constructs a static dashboard layout using DOM manipulation and Figma JSON coordinates. It includes functions to generate rectangles, text, and images positioned based on Figma data, and renders a detailed UI layout with sidebar, topbar, KPIs, and data tables.

methods.name: fx(x)
methods.description: Normalizes an x-coordinate from Figma space to canvas space using OFFSET_X.

methods.name: fy(y)
methods.description: Normalizes a y-coordinate from Figma space to canvas space using OFFSET_Y.

methods.name: addRect(parent, { id, x, y, w, h, className = '', radius = 16, style = {} })
methods.description: Creates and appends a div element styled as a rectangle at the specified Figma coordinates.

methods.name: addText(parent, { id, x, y, w, h, text, className = '', style = {} })
methods.description: Creates and appends a div element containing text at the specified Figma coordinates.

methods.name: addImage(parent, { id, x, y, w, h, src, className = '', style = {}, alt = '' })
methods.description: Creates and appends an img element at the specified Figma coordinates.

methods.name: render()
methods.description: Builds the entire static dashboard layout by invoking addRect, addText, and addImage for each component.

methods.name: applyScale()
methods.description: Scales the entire canvas view to fit the viewport width without exceeding a scale of 1.

search-terms: DOM element creation with Figma coordinates
